text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Financial guarantee certificate (parents' income certificate or bank deposit certificate) * 2. Foreigner Physical Examination Form A scanned copy (the applicant should keep the original). The Chinese quarantine authorities issue this form, which must be completed in English. It is advised to choose the date wisely, for the results are valid only for 6 months. * 3. Ordinary passport within the validity period (Scanned color copy) * 4. Digital colored photo in white background(Format: JPG:100-500KB) * 5. Transcript from high school with the official stamp Scanned color copies of original or notarized copies in Chinese or English. * 6. High school diploma or equivalent certificate Fresh graduates can provide pre-graduation certificate first) (scanned color copies of original or notarized copies in Chinese or English * 7. English proficiency test certificate * 8. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Test subjects: Mathematics(in English) and Chemistry(in English) Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
